summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed a routine Form 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting monthly net asset value per share as of August 31, 2026, across its seven share classes. NAV per share ranged from $10.5930 (Class S) to $11.2590 (Class E), with total NAV of $2.22 billion and 204,873 shares/units outstanding. The prior month's July 31 NAV is also disclosed for comparison. The filing contains no transaction, stakeholder action, board recommendation, advisor, or change-of-control event; it is a periodic valuation disclosure by a non-listed REIT.
